segment.source: Renders a service-state opening: a coloured state dot with its sentence, the headline, one measured value such as uptime or response time, and a link to the full history. Use it for: status and trust pages, uptime dashboards, incident communication, planned maintenance windows, service-level reporting. Prefer 'Announcement Hero' when the message is news rather than a live state, and 'Hero with Metrics' when several numbers matter equally.
